name: road_graph_benchmarks
description: A benchmark suite for evaluating algorithms that construct and analyze road network graphs, typically derived from imagery or map data. It measures graph extraction quality, connectivity, and fidelity to ground-truth road networks across varied conditions and geographies. The suite is intended for assessing graph-based ML models and geospatial processing pipelines.
reputation: A specialized geospatial/graph benchmark with limited but growing use among researchers working on road extraction and graph learning.
